## History

John Douglas courted [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet for twenty years without proposing due to a promise forced upon him by his mother to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone. During a visit to his house with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), his elderly mother made light comments about her eventual death and his future marriage, leaving John visibly tortured. After [Janet](../character/janet.md) sharply rejected his escort following a prayer meeting, John was left heartbroken until his mother passed away, after which he finally proposed to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and explained the reason for his long delay.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029), [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Janet](../character/janet.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

[Janet](../character/janet.md) and John Douglas share a long-standing romantic connection, as John quietly admired and visited her for twenty years without proposing [R1, S1, S2]. Their relationship faced severe strain when [Janet](../character/janet.md), advised to take a stand against his prolonged inaction, sharply rejected his escort, leaving John heartbroken [S2]. The dynamic finally shifted into an official engagement after John's mother passed away, allowing him to propose and reveal that he had been bound by a secret promise to his late mother to delay marriage until after her death [R1, S3].

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), +10 more_
